style: Say softly and calmly, like a mindfulness teacher
lines: Let's make a dance about a feeling. First, tap a feeling.
Happy.
Sad.
Calm.
Mad.
Surprised.
Think of a time you felt this. Tap Start, then a shape.
Now tap Middle and pick a middle move. How does the feeling move?
Last, tap End and pick an end shape. How does the feeling finish?
Your dance has a start, a middle and an end. Tap Watch it.
Here is one idea. Change a part, or tap Watch it.
Watch the scarf. Tap Play.
Did the scarf show your feeling, and how? Tap Your turn to try it.
Get your scarf, or use your hand. Find your start shape. Tap Go.
Freeze in your end shape, and breathe. Then tap Share.
Audience, tell the dancers what you saw. Tap the I saw chips.
A clear start!
The middle move!
A clear end!
You felt it!
Swap! New dancers, find your start shape. Tap Go again.
Start shape chosen. Tap Middle to choose a middle move.
Middle move chosen. Tap End to choose an end shape.
Your parts are ready. Tap a feeling to finish your dance.
Tap a feeling, then tap Feeling idea, or choose your three parts.
Tap Start, then tap a start shape.
Tap Middle, then tap a middle move.
Tap End, then tap an end shape.
Tap Play to watch, or tap a part card to change your dance.
Find your start shape. Tap Go to dance with the scarf.
Tap the I saw chips that match what your audience noticed. Tap Swap for new dancers.
Watch the scarf. Tap Stop to stop the dance, or tap a part card to change it.
Follow the scarf. Tap Stop to stop, or tap Mirror to flip the view.
Tap a start shape. Tap Done to return to the dance.
Tap a middle move. Tap Done to return to the dance.
Tap an end shape. Tap Done to return to the dance.
Tap a feeling. Tap Done to return to the dance.
Tap a start shape. Tap Middle to choose the moving part.
Tap a middle move. Tap End to choose the ending shape.
Tap an end shape. Tap Start or Middle to change another part.
Did the scarf show the feeling? Tap Your turn to dance it yourself.
New dancers, find your start shape. Tap Go again when you are ready.
Tap Build to finish your dance. Choose a feeling, a start shape, a middle move and an end shape.
Hold your end shape. Then tap Share to tell what you saw.
